positive.why: RIGHT JOIN с зеркальным порядком таблиц
positive.sql: SELECT pizzeria.name, pizzeria.rating FROM person_visits RIGHT JOIN pizzeria ON person_visits.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id WHERE person_visits.id IS NULL;

negative.sql: SELECT name, rating FROM pizzeria WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT pizzeria_id FROM person_visits);
SELECT name, rating FROM pizzeria WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_visits WHERE person_visits.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id);

negative.why: INNER JOIN даёт посещённые, а не непосещённые
negative.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pizzeria.name, pizzeria.rating FROM pizzeria JOIN person_visits ON person_visits.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id;

negative.why: нет проверки на NULL: все пиццерии (с повторами)
negative.sql: SELECT pizzeria.name, pizzeria.rating FROM pizzeria LEFT JOIN person_visits ON person_visits.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id;
